navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Use arrow keys → ← or 'A', 'D' keys to move side by side. And 'W' or ↑ to jump.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Try to avoid obstacles and keep at least 1 health before reaching GP. Hitting each obstacle costs one health.

funFact.title: Fun fact
funFact.description: Do you know that just by going to cervical screening can help prevent up to 90% of cervical cancers?

knowYourBody.title: Know your body
knowYourBody.description: Cultural beliefs, embarrassment, language barriers and fear of judgement can make cervical screening difficult to talk about. Let’s break the stigma and make screening conversations easier for everyone.

throughTheProcess.title: Through the process
throughTheProcess.description: Experience the process for cervical screening and explore its options either at GP or right at the comfort of your home.
